Kit summary

Thorn EnergyBasic
Deals 140% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to reduce their 30% DEF for 2 turns.
Cleansing ShieldActiveExclusive Lv.1
Grants all allies a [Shield] by 22% of Sylvan's Max HP for 2 turns and cleanses 1 type of random Attribute Debuffs from all allies.
Staff of Thorns Lv.1Cleansing Shield: Increases all allies' ATK by an extra 20% for 2 turns.
Tenacious WillPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies 22% more Effect RES when Sylvan survives. When multiple skills increase this attribute, only the strongest one will take effect.
Staff of Thorns Lv.2Restores HP by 3% of Sylvan's Max HP to the ally with the lowest HP whenever Sylvan successfully inflicts 1 type of debuffs.
Entangling ThornsActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 140% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 40% chance to inflict [Intertwined] for 2 turns and a 40% chance to reduce the target's ATK by 20% for 2 turns.
Staff of Thorns Lv.3Entangling Thorns: Increases the ATK reduction to 40%.
